meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 让 Claude 借助 Chat SDK 把 Microsoft Teams 作为聊天通道，可在团队频道、群聊和私聊中收发消息。需先创建并安装 Teams 机器人。
howto.when: 当你说“接入 Teams”“添加 Teams 频道”等请求，或要求运行 add-teams 配置流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Microsoft Teams 接入进来。
say.note: 会启动 add-teams 技能，开始复制适配器并引导配置。

say.text: 添加 Teams 聊天通道。
say.note: 运行技能，创建机器人并生成安装链接。

say.text: 把助手接到 Teams 私聊里。
say.note: 配置完成后会向指定 Teams 用户发起私聊。

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams as a chat channel via the Chat SDK bridge, enabling interactive chat in team channels, group chats, and direct messages. A Teams bot must be created and installed first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add or integrate Microsoft Teams as a chat channel, or run this skill's setup flow.

say_en.text: Help me add Microsoft Teams integration.
say_en.note: Starts the add-teams skill; it copies the adapter and guides setup.
Runs the skill, creates a bot, and produces an install link.

say_en.text: Connect the assistant to Teams DMs.
say_en.note: After setup, messages that Teams user first.
